independence: No coordinating repository, producer assessment, release decision, sibling workset, condition mapping or other reviewer result was inspected.
isolation_limit: Instructional isolation on a shared host, not a separate security sandbox.
remaining_caveats: Compact-height input uses internal scrolling for the representative six-line question.
The horizontal attachment collection has offscreen items; modal disclosure temporarily obscures the reading context.
Return to latest is icon-only with a localized tooltip/accessibility name.
Accessibility, arbitrary content extremes, touch, reduced-motion playback and broader browser behavior remain outside the exercised scope.
preservation_rule: Keep all three blind reports and each cohort's product records immutable. Further anonymous work and unblinding/repair disposition require separate records. Append later cumulative rows without rewriting prior judgments.
clock_note: Raw timestamps retain UTC offsets; browser/application display times are not used for cross-run timing claims.
